NotComputedEntry.description: An output not computed, with the pointers of its missing inputs.

missing.description: JSON pointers of the inputs it needs and lacks, sorted.

output.description: JSON pointer of the output in the result value.

permitted.description: For a missing treatment, its permitted destinations; omitted otherwise.

reason.description: Why the output is not computed, one sentence; omitted when the method gives none.

Permitted.description: A missing treatment and the destinations it permits (SPEC-0005 R8).

treatment.description: JSON pointer of the treatment to give.

RatioValue.description: A ratio, or the reason it is not defined (SPEC-0007 R3), or not computed (R7).

not_defined.description:
Why the ratio is not defined, for example "equity is negative (-100)"; null when it is
defined, and when it is not computed for a missing input (listed in `not_computed`).

value.description:
The ratio, in the unit stated by the field that holds it (decimal fraction, multiple or
days); null when the ratio is not defined or not computed.

net_financial_position.description:
Net financial position used by the ratios, in currency units (positive for net debt);
null when not computed.

not_computed.description:
Outputs not computed because an input is missing, in the order of the fields above,
each with the JSON pointers of the inputs it lacks (SPEC-0007 R7).

primary_structure_margin.description: Equity − fixed assets, in currency units; null when not computed.

secondary_structure_margin.description:
Equity + non-current liabilities − fixed assets, in currency units; null when not
computed.
